about_the_game: The game is a medieval style RPG, which has as its story a remarkable event in humanity that generated powers for all humans and also generated the gain of a power when winning a battle, and the loss of a power when losing a battle. The game has 13 playable characters, 4 of which can be played at the same time and the others are in reserve. The game has several innovative systems such as stealing skills when winning a battle and losing them when losing. It has an autobattle system, a huge variety of items, equipment, and powers available in the game. In the game's story, you face several challenges and several missions to do. The character can join a faction in the game, and each faction has its own lifestyle. The game has two possible endings. You will decide in the end how things will be, whether you break the curse of the loss of powers or not.
